item.title: Avatar: Seven Havens Creators Confirm New Details on Show’s Future
item.description: Avatar fans received good news this week with the announcement that Avatar: Seven Havens will return in just a few months. The second season of the show will officially be titled Book 2: Discovery, and is set to premiere on May 21, 2027 . Better still, Book 3 will also be released sometime next year. While that was the splashiest news executive producers Sheaj Sethi and Ethan Spaulding shared in a Reddit AMA , they also teased some details about what to expect from the show's future. Here's what we learned.

item.title: KPop Demon Hunters' 2027 World Tour Is Official, but There's a Catch
item.description: KPop Demon Hunters is packed with award-winning bops, so it’s no surprise Netflix and Sony Pictures Animation want to make the most of them with a live show. Netflix began planning a concert tour in March and confirmed today that Huntr/x will be going on tour in 2027. However, it's still unclear who will actually be performing the songs.

item.title: Avengers Endgame: Encore Now Officially Streaming on Disney Plus
item.description: With Avengers: Doomsday roughly a month away, Disney has some good news for MCU fans who want to be fully caught up before Doctor Doom blows through the Marvel pantheon. Marvel Studios' Avengers Endgame: Encore is now streaming on Disney Plus.

item.title: The 25 Best Switch 2 Games
item.description: That's in addition to stellar third-party support, with almost unanimous buy-in from indies and several big publishers going all-in on porting their biggest titles to Switch 2 — notably Square Enix, with the Final Fantasy 7 series, and Capcom, with Resident Evil, Onimusha, Pragmata , and more coming.

item.title: Xbox Shares New Fable Trailer that Divides the Fanbase
item.description: On Nov. 12, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma shared a new gameplay trailer for Fable , the long-anticipated fourth installment in the Fable series, developed by Playground Games. While excitement for the game remains high, many fans shared their negative reactions online, confirming that this will be another controversial release.

item.title: New Game from Doom studio and New Wolfenstein Announced
item.description: Xbox is celebrating its 25th anniversary this month, and it's been spoiling fans left and right. Xbox games like Minecraft , Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 , Gears E-Day , and more received celebratory freebies. Beyond the awesome free in-game items, players were lucky enough to get a few exciting announcements coming from Bethesda-owned studios, Id Software and MachineGames.

item.title: Pixar's New Movie Gatto Gets First In-Depth Look in Official Trailer
item.description: The first teaser for Gatto , Pixar's upcoming animated film, was released on Jun. 11, following a description of the movie's general plot and some cast members. Fans learned that Gatto is set in the Italian city of Venice, and it follows the adventures of a feral black cat named Nero, who's spent most of his nine lives recklessly working for mobster cat Rocco.

item.title: Leaked Dune Magic Secret Lair Has Amazing Value Reprints and 9 New Cards
item.description: One popular sci-fi property is the talk of the Magic: The Gathering community right now, and it's not Star Trek . On Nov. 12, leaks started to emerge online about a Dune Secret Lair drop, and while still unconfirmed, this new Universes Beyond collaboration seems legitimate.

item.title: 6 Nintendo Switch Special Editions With the Best Designs, Ranked
item.description: When a new console arrives, a lot of us rush out to buy one the minute we can afford to. At launch, there’s typically just one option, or sometimes a handful of choices with varying specifications. Personality isn’t a draw yet, beyond whatever’s standard. Over time, however, that inevitably changes.
